events.note: Tarik Muharemovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!

var_decision.note: GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Nikola Vasilj no chance!
